name: Magma Dragon (Ancient) OLD
savenote: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
90 feet. DC 37 Will Saving Throw

See rules...

A creature that first enters the area must attempt a Will save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this monster's Frightful Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Wing Deflection
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The dragon is targeted with an attack

Effect The dragon raises a wing, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the dragon is Flying, they descend 10 feet after the attack.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
The dragon breathes a blast of magma that deals 10d6 Fire Damage|options:area-damage]{10d6 fire damage and 5d12 bludgeoning damage} in a 60ft Cone (Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw save).

They can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one horn Strike in any order.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Momentum
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon recharges their Breath Weapon whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Magma Swim
offensiveAbilities.description: A magma dragon's swim Speed functions only when the dragon is Swimming through magma or molten lava.

offensiveAbilities.name: Magma Tomb
offensiveAbilities.description: Once per day, the dragon can spit a molten boulder at a target within 120 feet. This deals 12d6 Fire Damage]{12d6 fire damage and 5d12 bludgeoning damage}, with a Basic DC 42 Reflex Saving Throw save. If the creature fails its save, it's encased in magma that instantly cools and has Hardness 10, HP 40, and BT 20. The encased creature can't breathe and is Restrained (Escape dc=42).

offensiveAbilities.name: Volcanic Purge
offensiveAbilities.description: If the next action the dragon uses is Breath Weapon, the magma clings to those it damages. Each creature that fails its save against the Breath Weapon takes 5d6 Persistent,fire Damage damage, and as long as it has this persistent fire damage, it also takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds.

cantrips.name: Produce Flame
cantrips.description:
A small ball of flame appears in the palm of your hand, and you lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a spell attack roll against your target's AC. This is normally a ranged attack, but you can also make a melee attack against a creature in your unarmed reach.

On a success, you deal 2d4 fire damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage and (@item.level)d4 Persistent,fire Damage damage.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 1d4 and the persistent damage on a critical hit by 1d4.

lv4spells.name: Fire Shield (Constant)
lv4spells.description:
You wreathe yourself in ghostly flames, gaining cold resistance 5. Additionally, adjacent creatures that hit you with a melee attack, as well as creatures that touch you or hit you with an unarmed attack, take 2d6 fire damage each time they do.

Heightened (+2) The cold resistance increases by 5, and the fire damage increases by 1d6.

lv8spells.name: Burning Hands (At Will)
lv8spells.description:
Gouts of flame rush from your hands. You deal 2d6 fire damage to creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

lv8spells.name: Fireball
lv8spells.description:
A roaring blast of fire appears at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

lv8spells.name: Wall of Fire (At Will)
lv8spells.description:
You raise a blazing wall that burns creatures passing through it. You create either a 5-foot-thick wall of flame in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high, or a 5-foot-thick, 10-foot-radius ring of flame with the same height. The wall stands vertically in either form; if you wish, the wall can be of a shorter length or height. Everything on each side of the wall is Concealed from creatures on the opposite side. Any creature that crosses the wall or is occupying the wall's area at the start of its turn takes 4d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 1d6.

recallKnowledge: Arcana or Arcana or Nature, DC 38
